blocks.heading: {{business_name}}'s Story
paragraphs: {{business_name}}'s company history, leadership, and milestones backed by a detail should be reviewed before publication. Add confirmed founding, established, or incorporation details only when the tenant or a cited source supports the claim.

blocks.heading: A Legacy Built on Teamwork and Dedication
paragraphs: Our continued success is built on clear communication, dependable project delivery, and the experience of the people behind the work.

blocks.heading: A Culture of Stability and Tenure
paragraphs: {{business_name}} fosters a work environment that values stability and long-term commitment. This is reflected in the impressive tenure of our team members. This level of experience and continuity is a valuable asset to our company and our clients.

source_refs.note: Source narrative includes the Our Story heading and three subheaded text blocks about the source company's milestone, teamwork, and long-tenured staff. Tenant drafts must replace source-specific age claims with tenant facts backed by a detail.

blocks.heading: Experience You Can Trust, Delivered on Every Project
paragraphs: At {{business_name}}, we understand that your project is more than just bricks and mortar. It's a vision, an investment, and a reflection of your dreams. That's why we place the most experienced construction professionals at the helm of every project we undertake.
We're not just building structures, we're building trust. Every project is planned around practical guidance, reliable scheduling, and a clear standard of workmanship.

blocks.heading: Build with a team focused on the long term
paragraphs: We're grateful for the opportunity to serve our community and look forward to continuing to build a brighter future, together.

source_refs.note: Image-left split section uses the historic Harper sign photo and text about experience, trust, and the source company's milestone.
Source leadership includes Jeff Harper, Ron Harper, and Stephen Marble with biographical profile copy.

props.title: Our Valued Clients
props.intro: {{business_name}} has always embraced our clients and partners as part of Our Team. Every project is performed with open communication. The partnering methodology is implemented and a mutual respect with our clients provides the groundwork for our success.
